versions.subject: [OSCD] Two LOLBins: ftp.exe and Runscripthelper.exe
versions.detection:
ftp_path:
    Image|endswith: 'ftp.exe'
ftp_metadata:
    OriginalFileName|contains: 'ftp.exe'
cmd_with_script_modifier:
    CommandLine|contains: '-s:'
parent_path:
    ParentImage|endswith: 'ftp.exe'
condition: (ftp_path and cmd_with_script_modifier) or (ftp_metadata and cmd_with_script_modifier) or (ftp_metadata and not ftp_path) or parent_path
versions.spl: (Image="*ftp.exe" CommandLine="*-s:*") OR (OriginalFileName="*ftp.exe*" CommandLine="*-s:*") OR (OriginalFileName="*ftp.exe*" NOT Image="*ftp.exe") OR ParentImage="*ftp.exe"
